text:
amal: quick sync — i'm drafting the PRD for the observability console: flexible retention tiers + tracing UX + rollout gating. need to lock acceptance criteria and surface any customer-blocking asks (acmehealth, fincorp). can ppl drop quick wins vs blockers?

jen: from eng: +1 on tiers. blockers: storage budget API needs an admin endpoint (create/update quota), and a migration plan for existing orgs. also need SLOs for query latency at different retention windows.

santiago: design: high-level flow: 1) admin picks retention tier (30/90/365/custom), 2) preview cost delta, 3) confirm and schedule migration. want to add an inline "impact to queries" tooltip. will mock tomorrow.

mira: support: customer asks we see: a) ability to override per-team retention, b) export/purge on demand for audits, c) explainability for sampling. these are common for regulated customers.

patrick: data/storage: implement tiering by archiving older telemetry to columnar cold store. edge: preserving trace fidelity (span links) after cold move. we should spec a TTL+index shim so trace searches don't break.

eva: sales: prioritize per-team override and export/purge. these are immediate deals. if we can't promise per-team override at GA, we must be explicit in the PRD and offer a supported migration plan.

amal: acceptance criteria proposal (draft):
- Admin UI: select retention tier and schedule change (UI + API).
- Cost preview: show estimated monthly delta before commit.
- Query compatibility: searches and trace links return correct results for mixed hot/cold data.
- Rollout gating: canary 5% of orgs for 48h, rollback if error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency regresses > 20%.
- Compliance features: manual export + immediate purge endpoint implemented (audit logs included).
- Docs: migration guide + FAQ for customers.

jen: technical note: canary definition — we should run canary by org size buckets (small/med/large) not random. otherwise noisy. also need a feature-flag toggle that supports instant rollback.

santiago: UX edge cases: what happens when a retention shrink is requested mid-query? propose: changes apply after a scheduled window; during migration treat queries as read-through to cold store. show banner "migration in progress".

mira: support question: how do we communicate SLA changes? customers will ask about historic alerting and long-term dashboards. propose a notification plan + sample support scripts.

amal: risk log entries (short):
- Cost misestimation: cost preview must be conservative (10% buffer).
- Query regressions: need perf tests across retention windows.
- GDPR/exports: export + purge must be auditable.

jen: ops checklist for rollout:
- perf test suite across 30/90/365 retention (p50/p95/p99)
- dry-run of migration on staging orgs
- monitor: error_rate, p95, query-timeout count, cold-store egress cost
- alert thresholds wired to runbook

amal: decisions needed from PM + Eng:
- GA scope: per-team overrides in scope? (eva wants yes)
- Canary strategy: org-bucketed or percent-random? Jen prefers buckets.
- Export API: GA or beta? Mira prefers GA for regulated customers.

eva: sales asks to include a "compliance add-on" bundle in the PRD that includes expedited export support and SLA for purge. can we scope that as an enterprise add-on?

patrick: implementation note: for trace integrity after archiving we can keep a compact index of span ids in hot store. additional storage cost but preserves trace nav. include cost estimate in PRD.

amal: next steps: jen + patrick to add perf/cost estimates to the PRD by EOD Thursday. santiago to drop mocks and copy for banners. mira to draft support playbook. i'll consolidate and share PRD v0.1 Friday morning for async review. please emoji react when you see blockers.

deploy-bot: scheduled reminder set for 1732160000 to review PRD v0.1

jen: noted — i'll flag any infra blockers in the doc.

santiago: will post initial mocks in #design tomorrow.

amal: thanks — keeping this thread as the single source for quick questions during drafting.
